facts.text: Battlefield 6 Update 1.4.1.0 launched July 21, 2026 with Season 4: Pacific Front.
Season 4 introduced Tsuru Reef as a large-scale Pacific battleground with naval warfare across land, air and sea.
Update 1.4.1.0 introduced the Dynamic Wave System for ocean combat.
Season 4 introduced the 7.7m NSW RHIB and RCB-90 Patrol Boat along with new weapons and REDSEC updates.
Update 1.4.1.0 includes broad improvements across weapons, gadgets, vehicles, REDSEC, Portal, UI, audio and gameplay polish.
The official 1.4.1.0 update notes do not provide a definitive weapon meta ranking; a 'best weapon' claim therefore requires additional evidence beyond this patch snapshot.
